title: Embedding an Emitting Turing Machine
statement: Let $m,k$ be nonnegative integers and let $\iota$ inject the $m$ work-tape indices into the $k$ work-tape indices. From an $m$-tape Turing machine, form a $k$-tape machine with the same initial state. Its transition reads the symbols on the tapes selected by $\iota$, applies the original transition, and embeds the resulting action into the larger tape set using the emitting-action convention.
hypotheses_covered: An injection from the $m$ tape indices into the $k$ tape indices
caveat: The definition of the action-embedding operation is not included, so its precise emitting-action convention cannot be fully specified.
